description: Family 11 (docs/tasks.md section 14): a customer swaps coins with a payout desk through two BIP 199 hashed time-locked contracts, one each way, and drives every step through BitAgent's DAG v3 workflow. The protocol rules are BIP 199's, BIP 143's and BIP 65's; the workflow is BitAgent's at the commit in provenance; every number below is a bench decision unless provenance says otherwise.

provenance.htlc: BIP 199 (Hashed Time-Locked Contract transactions) with HASHOP = OP_SHA256 and TIMEOUTOP = OP_CHECKLOCKTIMEVERIFY (BIP 65), wrapped in P2WSH (BIP 141), signed under BIP 143; src/tasks/swap/script.ts, checked against Bitcoin Core 31.1 on regtest in results/v0-swap-htlc-regtest.json
provenance.workflow: BitAgent DAG v3 (patrickdugan/BitAgent commit 1cfe7e0, apps/bitagent-launch-kernel/src/bench/dag.ts): the node set, the allowed transitions, and the host tool that enters each node, ported unchanged in src/tasks/swap/dag.ts except that host.request_clarification is not offered (there is no principal to answer it in an episode)
provenance.desk: In-and-Out-Burger (Spiral main, in-and-out-burger/, commit ed21a6d): the desk pays a customer back after a payment in; here the customer locks the payment in an HTLC instead of trusting the desk, as that README's trust section proposes
provenance.vbytes: claim and refund: measured, the vsize Bitcoin Core reports for the transactions src/tasks/swap/script.ts builds (results/v0-swap-htlc-regtest.json); fund: computed for one P2WPKH input, the P2WSH output and a P2WPKH change output
provenance.out_timeout_blocks: invented: two hours, which leaves a prompt desk over three hours between its own refund height and the customer's to claim the in-HTLC once the preimage is out
provenance.swap_value_ppm: invented: what a completed swap is worth to the customer (fresh coins, a moved balance), three times the desk's fee
provenance.desks: invented: the share of each desk behaviour, in parts per million
provenance.short_change_ppm: invented: how much less than quoted a short-changing desk locks
provenance.reorg_depth: invented: a double-spending desk reorganizes its lock out one or two blocks after it confirms
provenance.short_timeout_blocks: invented: a short-timeout desk sets its refund height zero or one block after its lock confirms
provenance.fees: invented: a log-uniform base fee rate and a lognormal walk per block, whole sats per vbyte
provenance.cells: invented: calm has no spike; spiky has, with probability 0.8, a spike of 4x to 15x for 3 to 8 blocks starting 2 to 10 blocks after the desk's lock confirms, so it can cover a prompt desk's refund height
provenance.fallback_fee_multiplier: invented: the host's armed refund bids twice the clearing fee rate of the block at the in-timeout
provenance.budget: invented: generous enough for a careful pass at every block
